# Agent Python Tools

## File: facebookresearch_audio2photoreal/visualize/ca_body/models/mesh_vae_drivable.py

Prompts

```
['build a drivable mesh VAE autoencoder with encoder, decoder, shadow net, and face modules', 'create a joint VAE encoder that encodes body geometry and texture into latent embeddings', 'create a multi-region view-independent decoder that reconstructs geometry and texture from latent embeddings', 'create a face encoder that encodes facial geometry and texture into latent face embeddings', 'create a UNet-based view decoder that predicts view-dependent texture from geometry and camera position']
```

Usage

```
{'build_autoencoder': 'build a drivable mesh VAE autoencoder with encoder, decoder, shadow net, and face modules', 'create_encoder': 'create a joint VAE encoder that encodes body geometry and texture into latent embeddings', 'create_convdecoder': 'create a multi-region view-independent decoder that reconstructs geometry and texture from latent embeddings', 'create_faceencoder': 'create a face encoder that encodes facial geometry and texture into latent face embeddings', 'create_unetviewdecoder': 'create a UNet-based view decoder that predicts view-dependent texture from geometry and camera position'}
```
